subject: On‑prem pathway selection — recap, priority check, and next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Singh <tara@finsight.ai>, Connor Lee <connor.lee@finsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: On‑prem pathway selection — recap, priority check, and next steps

Hi Tara / Connor —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap so we’re aligned and to capture the recommended path we discussed: 

- Goal: Replace existing inference stack for real‑time scoring (sub‑200ms P95 target) and reduce per‑token cost for high‑volume end‑user features.
- Preferred deployment: On‑prem / VPC private deployment to meet data residency + audit requirements.
- Suggested approach: Start with a small dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) in your secure VPC for the pilot, then expand to 4x for production. We recommended using our quantization and prefix‑caching profiles (Profile B) to hit latency/cost targets.

Action items we agreed: 
1) I’ll share a one‑page Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a ballpark estimate for a dedicated on‑prem footprint.
2) You’ll confirm internal stakeholders and whether security will run a light questionnaire or a full SOC2 evidence request.
3) If pilot timing looks good, we’ll schedule an ops pairing session with our infra engineer (Stephanie) next week.

Attached: FinSight_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (draft), redwood_onprem_estimate.xlsx (ballpark).

Question for you: what’s the priority/window for this initiative inside the broader product roadmap? Are you aiming for a Q3 pilot or later? That will change recommended ramping and pricing.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555‑0123

Thanks — will try to get you a firm decision from the leadership sync on June 10.
